title: Yamen Probable NDE 5468
content: I had a severe bronchitis that evening that caused severe shortness of breath. I would wake up and take deep breaths as If I had just emerged from drowning in the ocean. I knew my breathing would stop at times; I was very tired and couldn’t open my eyes due to exhaustion. I suddenly felt extreme shortness of breath, which was followed by what felt like an explosion in my heart. I felt relief. I felt that this explosion released my struggling soul. My soul could now roam around where ever it wanted without obstacles. I felt complete freedom. I was now free and didn’t need a passport to cross boarders or move around the earth. I could even roam around the universe, but I didn’t want to leave Earth so I wouldn’t feel lonely. I was flying very easily. It was not a dream. The feeling of flying was very real. A being that looked like the Joker (from the card game) approached me. He was very friendly and gentle. He was my guide as I traveled. He directed me to the way to Brazil. I had always wanted to see Brazil. I arrived there very quickly. I was roaming above a heavy forest area as I suddenly felt another explosion in my heart. I saw myself on my bed. I was breathing violently and my heart was beating very hard as if it were knocking on my ribs. At that moment, I realized my breathing had stopped for a long time.

arrival.other_being_detail: A friendly, gentle being that looked like the Joker (from the card game) approached and acted as his guide.

environment.environment_other_detail: Brazil; roaming above a heavy forest area.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Return coincided with 'another explosion' in his heart and then he saw himself on his bed breathing violently with a hard heartbeat.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe bronchitis with severe shortness of breath; breathing stopped for a long time.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with a friendly guide-like being (looked like the Joker) and rapid travel to Brazil/forest area.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with immediate freedom/flying and travel on Earth; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described; return occurs after a second 'explosion' in the heart and seeing himself in bed.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A being resembling the Joker (card game) served as a friendly guide and directed travel to Brazil; emphasis on passport/borders and roaming Earth/universe.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My soul could now roam around where ever it wanted without obstacles. I felt complete freedom.” / “It was not a dream. The feeling of flying was very real.”
